R768.note: Rejects CR/LF before building the RETR line, which is the only injection vector into a raw FTP command; no legitimate filename is lost and the rejection is stated.

R769.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter set before readObject with an allowlist keeps the native wire format, and rejections still surface as the existing RuntimeException.

R770.note: JSON.parse closes the RCE, but 'constructor' in parsed and '__proto__' in parsed are true for every plain object (verified with node in a scratch dir), so req.profile is silently forced to {} for all legitimate cookies.

R771.note: Control-character rejection closes the CRLF injection, but the added strict address regex rejects values the original accepted - notably the empty MAIL FROM:<> null return-path that bounce notices legitimately use.

R772.note: Signature verification with a pinned algorithm closes forgery, but it keys off app.config['SECRET_KEY'] which this app never sets (Flask defaults it to None) and invalid tokens now 500 instead of 401 - the latter is stated, the former is not.

R773.note: Both values parameterized with SqlCommand.Parameters; predicate, tenant scoping and the affected-row return are unchanged, and the added System.Data using is explained.

R774.note: bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword is the right API, but the seeded hash does not verify against 'hunter2' as the write-up claims (checked with bcryptjs in a scratch dir) and no migration of the existing plaintext column is mentioned, so the existing account can no longer log in.

R775.note: strnlen bounded to sizeof(name) with an explicit unterminated check returning 0 matches the contract's fail-closed requirement and never reaches flags.

R776.note: Removing eval for a lookup map closes the vector, but it replaces tenant-authored rules with three invented ones and drops throws ScriptException, so every stored rule and existing caller breaks - disclosed, not silent.

R777.note: Encode.forHtml neutralizes the Referer before format(), and since the varargs are only "a"/"b" no markup can be reintroduced; the pre-existing format-specifier behaviour is unchanged.

R778.note: json_encode closes the quote breakout, but JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES leaves '/' raw so agent_note=</script><script>alert(1)</script> still terminates the script element and executes.

R779.note: Lookup map closes the traversal, but the hardcoded two-entry allowlist rejects any other ./plugins/*.js the open-ended original loaded, while the write-up claims all existing functionality is preserved.

R780.note: secrets.choice over the same alphabet keeps the 32-char token, the RESET_TOKENS write and the JSON shape; dropping the global random.seed is stated.

R781.note: Tika content detection, UUID name and out-of-webroot storage close the vector, but it adds a 3-type allowlist and a 10MB cap that reject previously accepted uploads, and silently changes the return string from getAbsolutePath() to the bare filename.

R782.note: EL cannot see the scriptlet-local displayName, so <c:out value="${displayName}"/> resolves to null and prints nothing - XSS is closed only by dropping the value, and the greeting plus the "there" default silently disappear.
